events.uncertainty: Caster announces draft between EVOS and NAVI, mapping it to series 1040. This is a draft announcement, not a full series boundary proof. The series boundary (24067s) is boundary-verified at medium confidence.

db_evidence.description: Per-game duration, winner, side and map mode for series 1040.
db_evidence.sql: select game_no, team_a, team_b, winner, duration_sec, team_a_side, team_b_side, map_mode from games where match_detail_id = :match_detail_id order by game_no
db_evidence.provenance: source-reported API detail; winner uses games.team_a/team_b orientation

db_evidence.description: Per-team per-game scoreboard aggregates for series 1040.
db_evidence.sql: select game_no, team, opponent, kills, deaths, assists, gold, tower_damage, duration_sec, win from team_games where match_detail_id = :match_detail_id order by game_no, team
db_evidence.provenance: deterministic aggregate from ten player rows; not an official tournament table

events.uncertainty: Game result is source-reported from the canonical DB. NAVI won in 10:56 with 7-2 kills and 29,195 tower damage. EVOS had 0 tower damage. Series boundary is boundary-verified at 24067s (medium confidence). No visual verification performed.
events.alternative_interpretation: The stomp may reflect EVOS errors, draft matchup, or execution rather than NAVI dominance.
